source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
COUNT(*) CNT 
FROM 
D360.STG_EDS_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET WHERE H = 'D'

scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [VEHICLE_TYPE]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_MTHS]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_YRS]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[VEHICLE_MODEL]
				,[VEHICLE_OWNER_NAME]
				,[VEHICLE_ENGINE_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_REGN_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_CHASSIS_NUM]
				,[SECU_CODE]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[SECU_SRL_NUM]
				,[LIMIT_B2KID]
				,[ACID]
				,[SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE]
				,[FILE_NAME]

)

				,[BANK_ID]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[VEHICLE_MODEL]
				,[VEHICLE_OWNER_NAME]
				,[VEHICLE_ENGINE_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_REGN_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_CHASSIS_NUM]
				,[SECU_CODE]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[SECU_SRL_NUM]
				,[LIMIT_B2KID]
				,[ACID]
				,[SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [VEHICLE_TYPE]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_MTHS]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_YRS]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[VEHICLE_MODEL]
				,[VEHICLE_OWNER_NAME]
				,[VEHICLE_ENGINE_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_REGN_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_CHASSIS_NUM]
				,[SECU_CODE]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[SECU_SRL_NUM]
				,[LIMIT_B2KID]
				,[ACID]
				,[SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.[VEHICLE_TYPE]
				,CC.[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_MTHS]
				,CC.[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_YRS]
				,CC.[BANK_ID]
				,CC.[TS_CNT]
				,CC.[RCRE_TIME]
				,CC.[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,CC.[LCHG_TIME]
				,CC.[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,CC.[VEHICLE_MODEL]
				,CC.[VEHICLE_OWNER_NAME]
				,CC.[VEHICLE_ENGINE_NUM]
				,CC.[VEHICLE_REGN_NUM]
				,CC.[VEHICLE_CHASSIS_NUM]
				,CC.[SECU_CODE]
				,CC.[DEL_FLG]
				,CC.[SECU_SRL_NUM]
				,CC.[LIMIT_B2KID]
				,CC.[ACID]
				,CC.[SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE]
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.LNS_COLTRLVEHDET CC
			JOIN d360.STG_EDS_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET B 
			ON CC.SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE = B.SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE
			AND CC.ACID = B.ACID
			AND CC.LIMIT_B2KID = B.LIMIT_B2KID
			AND CC.SECU_SRL_NUM = B.SECU_SRL_NUM
			AND CC.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET_GROUP_SRC
(
				 [VEHICLE_TYPE]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_MTHS]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_YRS]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[VEHICLE_MODEL]
				,[VEHICLE_OWNER_NAME]
				,[VEHICLE_ENGINE_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_REGN_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_CHASSIS_NUM]
				,[SECU_CODE]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[SECU_SRL_NUM]
				,[LIMIT_B2KID]
				,[ACID]
				,[SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT 
				,FILE_DATE
)

select 
				 [VEHICLE_TYPE]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_MTHS]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_YRS]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[VEHICLE_MODEL]
				,[VEHICLE_OWNER_NAME]
				,[VEHICLE_ENGINE_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_REGN_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_CHASSIS_NUM]
				,[SECU_CODE]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[SECU_SRL_NUM]
				,[LIMIT_B2KID]
				,[ACID]
				,[SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [VEHICLE_TYPE]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_MTHS]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_YRS]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[VEHICLE_MODEL]
				,[VEHICLE_OWNER_NAME]
				,[VEHICLE_ENGINE_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_REGN_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_CHASSIS_NUM]
				,[SECU_CODE]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[SECU_SRL_NUM]
				,[LIMIT_B2KID]
				,[ACID]
				,[SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY     [VEHICLE_TYPE]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_MTHS]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_YRS]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[VEHICLE_MODEL]
				,[VEHICLE_OWNER_NAME]
				,[VEHICLE_ENGINE_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_REGN_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_CHASSIS_NUM]
				,[SECU_CODE]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[SECU_SRL_NUM]
				,[LIMIT_B2KID]
				,[ACID]
				,[SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.LNS_COLTRLVEHDET A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.ACID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ACID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.LIMIT_B2KID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.LIMIT_B2KID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.SECU_SRL_NUM,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SECU_SRL_NUM,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

(
				 [VEHICLE_TYPE]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_MTHS]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_YRS]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[TS_CNT]

				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[VEHICLE_MODEL]
				,[VEHICLE_OWNER_NAME]
				,[VEHICLE_ENGINE_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_REGN_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_CHASSIS_NUM]
				,[SECU_CODE]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[SECU_SRL_NUM]
				,[LIMIT_B2KID]
				,[ACID]
				,[SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE]
				,SCD_START_DATE 
				,SCD_END_DATE
				,ISACTIVE
				,ISLATEST
				,BNK_CODE
				,SOURCE_CODE 
				,FILE_NAME 
				,insert_dttm
)
SELECT
				 [VEHICLE_TYPE]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_MTHS]
				,[MANUFACTUREYR_IN_YRS]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[VEHICLE_MODEL]
				,[VEHICLE_OWNER_NAME]
				,[VEHICLE_ENGINE_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_REGN_NUM]
				,[VEHICLE_CHASSIS_NUM]
				,[SECU_CODE]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[SECU_SRL_NUM]
				,[LIMIT_B2KID]
				,[ACID]
				,[SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE]
				,FILE_DATE
				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5)
				,'LNS'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_LNS_COLTRLVEHDET_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
